quotes.title: K2-72
quotes.card: K2-72 is a cool red dwarf star of spectral class M2V located about 217 light-years away from the Earth in the constellation of Aquarius.
quotes.introduction: It is known to host four planets, all similar in size to Earth, with one of them residing within the habitable zone.
